First, there was an incident where my mom didn't believe in doctors, and she put off taking my siblings and me to the doctor even when we were really sick. I had a serious health issue where I was hospitalized for weeks and had to spend several months on bed rest recovering. That experience was really traumatic for me, and I feel like my mom's actions almost cost me my life. I told her that what she did wasn't okay, and that if she keeps doing that, one of us might die someday because of her choices. She didn't take it well, but eventually, she dropped the conversation and brushed it off as no big deal. Then, later that day, she asked me to grab her a drink and said, "Well, you should know what I like, I've only raised you for 26 years!" I responded by saying that I don't know what she likes because my grandparents raised me, and I still don't know anything about her. She got upset, started crying, and accused me of trying to make her seem like a bad person. I tried to explain that I wasn't trying to be mean, but I was just saying that it's not cool to not take her kids to the doctor, and that I don't know anything about her since I didn't grow up with her. We ended up going home shortly after, and a few weeks later, we went out again. Then, there was another incident involving my brother's phone. My brother had a phone that a different family member pays for, and they kept taking it. I wanted him to have his own phone, so I made it clear that they can keep his other one, and this one is strictly for him. However, I found out that they've been taking and using this one too.
